title: Complete holistic NVQ mapping and assessor observation coverage
details: Every selectable Level 3 NVQ evidence area now maps to at least one relevant AC
Empty holistic areas are repaired from their P/T themes and official handbook wording
Existing Level 3 course packs are remapped once so old empty areas are removed
ACs observed as competent in Milos now show a blue o in Evia and count as covered
Apprenticeship KSB arches also show a blue Milos observed badge and observed KSB summary
